blurb: First human-made object to reach another world — it crashed into the Moon on purpose.
name: Luna 2

blurb: Aimed at the Moon but missed — it became the first spacecraft to fly past the Moon and orbit the Sun.
name: Luna 1

blurb: Snapped the first photos of the Moon's far side, which no human had ever seen.
name: Luna 3

blurb: First soft landing on the Moon — it survived touchdown and sent back photos from the surface.
name: Luna 9

blurb: America's first soft Moon landing, scouting safe landing spots for Apollo astronauts.
name: Surveyor 1

blurb: First crewed trip around the Moon — its crew took the famous 'Earthrise' photo.
name: Apollo 8

blurb: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the Moon.
name: Apollo 11

blurb: Pinpoint landing in the Ocean of Storms, right next to the old Surveyor 3 probe.
name: Apollo 12

blurb: Alan Shepard famously hit two golf balls across the lunar surface.
name: Apollo 14

blurb: First mission with the lunar rover — astronauts drove across the Moon!
name: Apollo 15

blurb: Explored the Descartes highlands — the only Apollo landing in the lunar highlands.
name: Apollo 16

blurb: The last Apollo Moon landing — and the only scientist ever to walk on the Moon.
name: Apollo 17

blurb: Still mapping the Moon in stunning detail after 15+ years in orbit.
name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter

blurb: China's first Moon landing, carrying the Yutu rover to the Sea of Rains.
name: Chang'e 3

blurb: First landing ever on the Moon's far side, inside Von Kármán crater.
name: Chang'e 4

blurb: India's first Moon landing, touching down near the lunar south pole.
name: Chandrayaan-3

blurb: Japan's 'Moon Sniper' landed within 100 meters of its target — a bullseye!
name: SLIM

blurb: First commercial Moon landing — it tipped over but kept phoning home.
name: Odysseus (IM-1)

blurb: First close-up photos of Mars — it flew past and snapped 22 pictures.
name: Mariner 4

blurb: First spacecraft to orbit Mars, mapping the entire planet.
name: Mariner 9

blurb: First successful Mars landing, touching down in Chryse Planitia.
name: Viking 1

blurb: Landed in Utopia Planitia and photographed frost on Mars.
name: Viking 2

blurb: Delivered Sojourner, the first rover to drive on Mars.
name: Pathfinder

blurb: Mapped Mars in detail from orbit for a full decade.
name: Mars Global Surveyor

blurb: Built for 90 days, it explored Gusev Crater for 6 years.
name: Spirit

blurb: The marathon rover — it drove a full marathon's distance across Mars!
name: Opportunity

blurb: Landed near the north pole and found water ice just under the soil.
name: Phoenix

blurb: A car-sized rover still climbing Mount Sharp in Gale Crater today.
name: Curiosity

blurb: A stationary lander that listened for marsquakes until 2022.
name: InSight

blurb: Collecting rock samples in Jezero Crater for a future trip back to Earth.
name: Perseverance

blurb: China's first Mars rover, exploring Utopia Planitia before hibernating.
name: Zhurong

blurb: The UAE's first Mars mission, studying the Martian atmosphere.
name: Hope (EMM)
